Close with `timon task done <id> --merged-sha <SHA>` (40 hex; see `git rev-parse HEAD`), or include that full sha in your comment.
daemonMessages.merge_sha_abbreviated: {guard, select, code_self {Code-self guard: this task must merge its own branch. } other {}}Merge guard: DONE is rejected without merged_commit_sha — the branch was not merged (or the SHA was not recorded). Your comment contains {short}, which looks like an ABBREVIATED SHA: the guard accepts only the full form (40 hex). Resolve it with `git rev-parse {short}` then close with `timon task done <id> --merged-sha <SHA-40-hex>`.
daemonMessages.review_verdict_unparsable: Review verdict not parsable in done_comment (expected: JSON with "verdict": "pass" or "changes_requested"). done_comment received: {excerpt, select, none {(empty)} other {{excerpt}}}
daemonMessages.backend_cannot_read_attachments: Backend `{backend}` cannot read files on this host (no `attachments` capability), and this task has {count, plural, one {# attached file} other {# attached files}}. Assign the task to an agent on a local backend, set a local backend on the task (backend override), or remove the attachments.
daemonMessages.backend_cannot_use_worktree: Backend `{backend}` does not work in Timon's folder (no `worktree` capability), so a `{type}` task cannot run on it. Assign the task to an agent on a local backend, or set a local backend on the task (backend override) or on the project's role.
daemonMessages.task_extras_widen: An agent's mission wrote this task, and its extras would give agent "{agent}" more than it holds: {refusal}. Remove these extras from the task, or grant them to "{agent}" first, then retry the task.

The mission was not started: restore this folder, or change the working directory of the agent or its project, then retry the task.
daemonMessages.task_spawn_failed: Spawn failed ({attempts}×): {error}. The mission never started — this is not a business block.{exhausted, plural, =0 {} other { Automatic retries are exhausted (# system deaths in a row): Timon will not replay this task on its own any more. Once the cause is dealt with, restart it by hand: move it back to Pending on the board, or run `timon task update {taskId} --status PENDING`.}}
daemonMessages.task_interrupted: Mission interrupted: {reason, select, rate_limit {account usage limit reached{window, select, none { (unknown window)} other { ({window})}}{reopens, select, none {, reopening time not reported by the backend} other {, quota reopens at {reopens}, the task restarts on its own after that}}} exhausted {account out of credit (HTTP 402) — nothing reopens on its own, it has to be topped up. The series fallback takes over} backend_unavailable {backend structurally unavailable — the CLI reported an authentication failure, or several missions returned instantly without producing a single turn (expired login, no credit left, dead endpoint). The series fallback takes over} overloaded {the provider reported the model at capacity (overloaded) — transient; the task moves to its fallback backend when one exists, otherwise it is replayed later} permission_denied {permission denied on a tool use (the CLI stops dead, the task is not closed out)} killed {process killed (manual stop or idle-mission reap)} stopped {turn stopped by hand from the chat (the conversation stays resumable)} timeout {turn silent too long — no output from the agent within the hung threshold (hung reap)} turn_budget {turn ran past its duration budget while still active (turn budget reap)} crash {unexpected stop of the process or of the orchestrator} other {undetermined cause — the process died without closing the task out and its stream yielded no usable signal}} — observed at {observed}. This is NOT a business block: the task was never closed out by the agent.{lastError, select, none {} other { Last error: {lastError}}}{context, select, spawn_refused { The turn was refused before spawn.} boot_orphan { Orphan reconciled at boot: the mission finished without transitioning the task.} other {}}{exhausted, plural, =0 {} other { Automatic retries are exhausted (# system deaths in a row): Timon will not replay this task on its own any more. Once the cause is dealt with, restart it by hand: move it back to Pending on the board, or run `timon task update {taskId} --status PENDING`.}}
daemonMessages.merge_held_no_verdict: Merge held: review {reviewId} is DONE but its done_comment carries NO usable verdict (expected a first line `verdict: pass` or `verdict: changes_requested`). Without an explicit verdict there is no merge. Have the review closed again with a verdict, or unblock it by hand after reading the diff.
daemonMessages.repair_wait_stalled: Review {reviewId} of code {codeId} requested changes, waiting for the repair iteration — no iteration has appeared in {waited} min (limit {limit} min). The verification loop did not create one (iteration cap reached, chain root gone, or a lost event). Create the repair iteration by hand, or re-run the review, then unblock this task.
daemonMessages.git_missing_for_task: git not found on this host: code, review and merge tasks of a git project need git. Install git, then restart Timon.
daemonMessages.integration_branch_unset: Integration mode "{mode}" needs an integration branch and the remote ref to cut it from (base "{branch}", remote ref "{baseRef}"). The task was not started: set both on the task, then retry it.
daemonMessages.integration_branch_unavailable: Integration branch {branch} is unavailable: {detail}. The task was not started, and the branch is never cut from the local base instead of {baseRef}. Fix the remote or the branch name, then retry the task.
daemonMessages.task_base_missing: Base {base} does not exist in the repository. The task was not started: a {type} task never runs without its base. Create the branch or change the task's base, then retry it.
daemonMessages.task_worktree_unavailable: No worktree for this {type} task ({cause}). It was not started: in the agent's own folder it would write to the checkout every agent shares. Fix the cause, then retry the task.

backend_signed_out.body:
The `{backend}` CLI reports an authentication failure (its session expired and could not be refreshed).

**Action needed:** sign in to the `{backend}` CLI again on this machine. Nothing retries it into working.

- Backend sidelined until {until, date, medium} {until, time, short}, or until a turn succeeds on it.
- Missions and tasks that depend on it switch onto their fallback plan.

backend_account_signed_out.title: {backend} account "{account}": signed out — sign in again
backend_account_signed_out.body:
The `{backend}` CLI reports an authentication failure on the account "{account}".

**Action needed:** sign this account in again. Until then its missions are refused; they never move to another subscription (an orchestrator piloting a series may move to another connection of its owner), and the other accounts keep running.
